front.title: Framework for Multi-domain IPv6-only Network and IPv4-as-a-Service

abstract.t: This document presents a framework, from the network operators' perspective, for building and operating IPv6-only core networks that span multiple domains (i.e., multiple interconnected Autonomous Systems). To carry residual IPv4 traffic in such an environment, the framework proposes stateless IPv4/IPv6 address mapping as the basis for IPv4-as-a-Service (IPv4aaS), so that IPv4 packets are translated at the network edge and forwarded across the IPv6-only core network without per-flow state or IPv4/IPv6 conversion gateways on the data path. The document is intended as a network operator problem statement, guidance, and requirements rather than a protocol specification. It covers the scope of applicability and trust boundaries, options for IPv6 mapping prefix allocation, and operational, manageability, and security considerations.
